description.en-US: The general logistics behaviour of the location. Only 'internal' holds company-owned stock. The others are the counterparties and virtual locations every movement needs an opposite side for: a receipt comes from 'vendor', a delivery goes to 'customer', an inventory adjustment balances against 'inventory_loss', a scrap moves to 'scrap', a multi-step or inter-warehouse flow parks stock in 'transit', and 'virtual' is an organisational node holding nothing. Distinct from 'purpose', which says what a location is used for inside a warehouse.

What the location is for inside its warehouse. Null is normal for a location outside any warehouse: a vendor location has no warehouse purpose. This is why Zone, Receiving Area, Dock and Picking Area are not separate resources — they are locations differing by purpose and by where they sit in the tree.

The warehouse this location belongs to, or null. Nullable on purpose: vendor, customer, inventory-loss and shared transit locations belong to no warehouse, and a shared transit location between two warehouses must not belong to either.

Parent in the location tree. Null for a root location. The tree must stay acyclic, which the engine enforces because the schema cannot. When both a location and its parent belong to a warehouse, it must be the same warehouse.

Cached human-readable path, such as 'MAIN/Stock/Zone A/Rack A01'. Derived from the tree and maintained by the domain service, which rewrites it for every descendant when a location moves. parent_location_id remains the source of truth.
How deep the location sits in its tree; 0 for a root. Derived alongside complete_path.
Capacity and mixing policy for this location, if any. Only meaningful for a location that can actually hold goods.
The order in which goods should be taken from this location's subtree. Configuration only: Warehouse states the preference and the Stock reservation engine is what applies it when choosing quants.

True for the locations a warehouse creates for itself — its root, Stock, and the Input, Quality Control, Packing and Output stops its flows require. Clients may never set this: only the warehouse domain service creates such locations, and they are protected from being restructured or archived while the warehouse still needs them.

Operational state, separate from is_archived. 'suspended' means temporarily out of use — a damaged rack, an area under repair, a zone being investigated — and, unlike archiving, is allowed while the location still holds stock: locking a location that holds goods is exactly what it is for. A location is usable only when it is active, unarchived, and its warehouse (if any) is likewise.
